features.name: Open Hand Technique
features.desc: When you hit with a strike from Flurry of Blows, you impose one effect (without spending extra Focus Points): knock the target Prone (Dexterity saving throw), push it 15 feet away (Strength saving throw), or deny it Reactions until its next turn.

features.name: Wholeness of Body
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, you heal yourself for 3 × your Monk level Hit Points. The number of uses equals your Proficiency Bonus (per Long Rest).

features.name: Fleet Step
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, you hide with Advantage if there are no brightly lit areas nearby; you gain Advantage on Initiative.

features.name: Quivering Palm
features.desc: When you hit with an Unarmed Strike, you can spend 4 Focus Points to start imperceptible vibrations (lasting up to 1 month). As an action, you end them: the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or drop to 0 Hit Points (on a success, it takes 10d12 Force damage). One target at a time.
